Entries.Title: Jurassic World Rebirth
Entries.Description: Five years after the events of Jurassic World Dominion, covert operations expert Zora Bennett is contracted to lead a skilled team on a top-secret mission to secure genetic material from the world's three most massive dinosaurs. When Zora's operation intersects with a civilian family whose boating expedition was capsized, they all find themselves stranded on an island where they come face-to-face with a sinister, shocking discovery that's been hidden from the world for decades.

Entries.Title: Angels Fallen: Warriors of Peace
Entries.Description: When an Iraq War veteran receives a calling from a higher power, he embarks on a mission to stop a fallen angel from raising an army of the dead to take over the world.

Entries.Title: Long Distance
Entries.Description: After crash-landing on an alien planet, an asteroid miner must contend with the challenges of his new surroundings, while making his way across the harsh terrain to the only other survivor – a woman who is trapped in her escape pod.

Entries.Title: Sonic the Hedgehog 3
Entries.Description: Sonic, Knuckles, and Tails reunite against a powerful new adversary, Shadow, a mysterious villain with powers unlike anything they have faced before. With their abilities outmatched in every way, Team Sonic must seek out an unlikely alliance in hopes of stopping Shadow and protecting the planet.

Entries.Title: The Twisters
Entries.Description: A deadly patchwork of destructive cyclones is on an apocalyptic path of convergence at a populated Midwest city center. There, the twisters will merge into one mega tornado that threatens to obliterate the cities for hundreds of miles around.

Entries.Title: Crazy Lizard
Entries.Description: A young man climbs into the mountains to pick up a meteorite that has fallen there and is killed by something. The "thing" descends to the village and begins to eat the inhabitants one by one, terrorizing the entire island.

Entries.Title: Deadpool & Wolverine
Entries.Description: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.

Entries.Title: Venom: The Last Dance
Entries.Description: Eddie and Venom are on the run. Hunted by both of their worlds and with the net closing in, the duo are forced into a devastating decision that will bring the curtains down on Venom and Eddie's last dance.

Entries.Title: First Shift
Entries.Description: NYPD veteran Mike and rookie Angela tackle a high-stakes day on New York's toughest streets, diving headfirst into a vortex of danger and action. Their adrenaline-fueled pursuits and unexpected threats unfold as they navigate perilous encounters. Amidst the chaos, intense challenges forge unbreakable bonds.

Entries.Title: The Roundup: Punishment
Entries.Description: 'Monster Cop' Ma Seok-do investigates an illegal online gambling business led by a former STS Baek and an IT genius CEO Chang. Ma proposes an unexpected alliance to Jang and begins hunting down the criminals.

Entries.Title: Gladiator II
Entries.Description: Years after witnessing the death of the revered hero Maximus at the hands of his uncle, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum after his home is conquered by the tyrannical Emperors who now lead Rome with an iron fist. With rage in his heart and the future of the Empire at stake, Lucius must look to his past to find strength and honor to return the glory of Rome to its people.

Entries.Title: Kraven the Hunter
Entries.Description: Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

Entries.Title: Kung Fu Panda 4
Entries.Description: Po is gearing up to become the spiritual leader of his Valley of Peace, but also needs someone to take his place as Dragon Warrior. As such, he will train a new kung fu practitioner for the spot and will encounter a villain called the Chameleon who conjures villains from the past.

Entries.Title: Utopia
Entries.Description: A soldier searching for his missing wife breaks into a high-tech facility, believing she's been caught in a human trafficking ring. But beyond its walls, he finds a surreal, futuristic fantasy park where reality and illusion blur. As he navigates this seductive and dangerous world, a shocking truth pulls him deeper into a deadly game where nothing is as it seems.

Entries.Title: Hunt the Wicked
Entries.Description: The film tells the story of narcotics police officer Huang Mingjin and the "mysterious figure" Wei Yunzhou. Through completely different means and methods, in the process of calculating and wrestling with each other, they tear apart the facade of urban tranquility, exposing the underground drug network woven by the hidden hand "Long Wang", and ultimately eradicate the darkness with the sword of justice, revealing the dawn of light.

Entries.Title: Red One
Entries.Description: After Santa Claus (codename: Red One) is kidnapped, the North Pole's Head of Security must team up with the world's most infamous tracker in a globe-trotting, action-packed mission to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Life After Fighting
Entries.Description: Retired martial arts world champion Alex Faulkner has settled into a simple life, when the disappearance of two of his students leads to an unthinkable discovery close to home. Just when all hope of finding the children is lost, he locates the imprisoned girls and unsurfaces an international child trafficking operation, which draws him back into the fight of his life against those behind it.

Entries.Title: Road House
Entries.Description: Ex-UFC fighter Dalton takes a job as a bouncer at a Florida Keys roadhouse, only to discover that this paradise is not all it seems.

Entries.Title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
Entries.Description: Following their explosive showdown, Godzilla and Kong must reunite against a colossal undiscovered threat hidden within our world, challenging their very existence – and our own.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Z: The Beginning of the End
Entries.Description: When a kind of rabies that transforms people into aggressive creatures spreads across the planet, Manel isolates himself at home with his cat, relying on his wits to survive; but soon they must go out in search of food, by land and by sea, dodging many dangers.

Entries.Title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
Entries.Description: After their late former Captain is framed, Lowrey and Burnett try to clear his name, only to end up on the run themselves.

Entries.Title: Moana 2
Entries.Description: After receiving an unexpected call from her wayfinding ancestors, Moana journeys alongside Maui and a new crew to the far seas of Oceania and into dangerous, long-lost waters for an adventure unlike anything she's ever faced.

Entries.Title: The Green Dinosaur
Entries.Description: When the world around him is mysteriously erased, a little green dinosaur named Diplodocus must travel through the pages of a comic book and adventure through time to bring color back to his land. Alongside a wizard and two scientists, Diplo’s plans go awry as he learns that there may be a dimension to his world that he never considered.

Entries.Title: SuperKlaus
Entries.Description: Santa Claus's wish comes true when he accidentally bumps his head and starts believing he's SuperKlaus. With the help of Billie and Leo his elf-xecutive assistant, SuperKlaus will take on a toy-obsessed businessman to save Christmas.

Entries.Title: Inside Out 2
Entries.Description: Teenager Riley's mind headquarters is undergoing a sudden demolition to make room for something entirely unexpected: new Emotions! Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust, who’ve long been running a successful operation by all accounts, aren’t sure how to feel when Anxiety shows up. And it looks like she’s not alone.

Entries.Title: Mufasa: The Lion King
Entries.Description: Mufasa, a cub lost and alone, meets a sympathetic lion named Taka, the heir to a royal bloodline. The chance meeting sets in motion an expansive journey of a group of misfits searching for their destiny.

Entries.Title: Flow
Entries.Description: A solitary cat, displaced by a great flood, finds refuge on a boat with various species and must navigate the challenges of adapting to a transformed world together.

Entries.Title: Dune: Part Two
Entries.Description: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

Entries.Title: Bambi: A Life in the Woods
Entries.Description: The life of Bambi, a male roe deer, from his birth through childhood, the loss of his mother, the finding of a mate, the lessons he learns from his father, and the experience he gains about the dangers posed by human hunters in the forest.

Entries.Title: Solo Leveling -ReAwakening-
Entries.Description: Over a decade after 'gates' connecting worlds appeared, awakening 'hunters' with superpowers, weakest hunter Sung Jinwoo encounters a double dungeon and accepts a mysterious quest, becoming the only one able to level up, changing his fate. A catch-up recap of the first season coupled with an exclusive sneak peek of the first two episodes of the highly anticipated second season in one momentous theatrical fan experience.

Entries.Title: The Garfield Movie
Entries.Description: Garfield, the world-famous, Monday-hating, lasagna-loving indoor cat, is about to have a wild outdoor adventure! After an unexpected reunion with his long-lost father – scruffy street cat Vic – Garfield and his canine friend Odie are forced from their perfectly pampered life into joining Vic in a hilarious, high-stakes heist.

Entries.Title: Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes
Entries.Description: Several generations following Caesar's reign, apes – now the dominant species – live harmoniously while humans have been reduced to living in the shadows. As a new tyrannical ape leader builds his empire, one young ape undertakes a harrowing journey that will cause him to question all he's known about the past and to make choices that will define a future for apes and humans alike.

Entries.Title: Miraculous World: London, At the Edge of Time
Entries.Description: To save the future from a terrible fate, Marinette becomes Chronobug and teams up with Bunnyx to defeat a mysterious opponent who travels through time. Who is this new supervillain, and why are they obsessed with exposing Marinette's secret superhero identity? Marinette's only hope is to defeat her new opponent to prevent the end of Ladybug and time itself!

Entries.Title: Night Carnage
Entries.Description: A blogger who is also a werewolf meets a dashing playboy with a dark secret of his own. Starring Logan Andrews and Christian Howard.

Entries.Title: 28 Years Later
Entries.Description: Twenty-eight years since the rage virus escaped a biological weapons laboratory, now, still in a ruthlessly enforced quarantine, some have found ways to exist amidst the infected. One such group lives on a small island connected to the mainland by a single, heavily-defended causeway. When one member departs on a mission into the dark heart of the mainland, he discovers secrets, wonders, and horrors that have mutated not only the infected but other survivors as well.

Entries.Title: Abraham's Boys: A Dracula Story
Entries.Description: Following the events of Dracula, Abraham van Helsing moves his two sons, Max and Rudy, to the US in an attempt to escape their past. It does not work.

Entries.Title: Final Destination Bloodlines
Entries.Description: Plagued by a violent recurring nightmare, college student Stefanie heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

Entries.Title: Weapons
Entries.Description: When all but one child from the same class mysteriously vanish on the same night at exactly the same time, a community is left questioning who or what is behind their disappearance.

Entries.Title: Hook
Entries.Description: Driven by a hallucinogenic drug and a thirst for revenge, James Hook murders John Darling and loses his hand to Peter Pan. Eighteen years later, Wendy, now married to Peter, has a daughter, Lily. Lily discovers Hook is her biological father, leading her to a remote birthday retreat. Hook escapes prison and embarks on a killing spree, targeting Lily and her friends at the manor.

Entries.Title: Fréwaka
Entries.Description: Care worker Shoo, who is haunted by a personal tragedy, is sent to a remote village to care for an agoraphobic woman, who fears both her neighbours and the Na Sídhe – sinister folkloric entities she believes abducted her decades before.

Entries.Title: Together
Entries.Description: With a move to the countryside already testing the limits of a couple's relationship, a supernatural encounter begins an extreme transformation of their love, their lives, and their flesh.

Entries.Title: Bring Her Back
Entries.Description: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are introduced to their new sibling by their foster mother, only to learn that she has a terrifying secret.

Entries.Title: T.I.M.
Entries.Description: Prosthetics scientist Abi and her adulterous husband Paul adjust to life outside the city as Abi begins working for high-tech company Integrate, developing a humanoid AI - T.I.M.

Entries.Title: Séance Games: Metaxu
Entries.Description: Social media stars unite to play METAXU, an online séance game, only to find they have unwittingly unleashed the Gates of Hell.

Entries.Title: Dangerous Animals
Entries.Description: A savvy and free-spirited surfer is abducted by a shark-obsessed serial killer. Held captive on his boat, she must figure out how to escape before he carries out a ritualistic feeding to the sharks below.

Entries.Title: Everyone Is Going to Die
Entries.Description: On his daughter's birthday, a wealthy father's reconciliation attempt is hijacked by two female burglars. A shakedown evolves into a lethal cat-and-mouse as hidden motives emerge, culminating in a life-altering revelation.

Entries.Title: The Ritual
Entries.Description: Two priests, one in crisis with his faith and the other confronting a turbulent past, must overcome their differences to perform a risky exorcism.

Entries.Title: Control Room
Entries.Description: A distant space colony where Olivia and her colleague Arlo is in charge of the colony's control room, ensuring the safety and well-being of the community. But the colony comes under siege from alien creatures.

Entries.Title: Sin él
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Nudus
Entries.Description: As she awakens from a prolonged coma, a woman is shocked to learn all the details of her life her captors her captors have access to.

Entries.Title: Clown in a Cornfield
Entries.Description: Quinn and her father have just moved to the quiet town of Kettle Springs hoping for a fresh start. Instead, she discovers a fractured community that has fallen on hard times after the treasured Baypen Corn Syrup Factory burned down. As the locals bicker amongst themselves and tensions boil over, a sinister, grinning figure emerges from the cornfields to cleanse the town of its burdens, one bloody victim at a time.

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Entries.Title: Sagrado
Entries.Description: The members of the Sagrado family live to prove they are the most powerful and influential, stopping at nothing to bury dirty secrets to keep their name faultless and sacred.

Episodes.Title: Brotherhood
Episodes.Description: Despite his father's opposition, Moises persists in attending Crestwood University. While seeking employment to fund his education, he meets Justin, a member of the influential Sagrado family, triggering a recollection of a dark secret.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: While Justin and his Gamma Sigma Xi fraternity brothers work to conceal the death of their hazing victim, Moises stumbles upon crucial evidence that could shed light on the truth behind the victim's demise.

Episodes.Title: Newbie
Episodes.Description: Elias expresses his intention to run as president during Justin's birthday party. Tension rises among the Gamma Sigma Xi members amid the cover-up of Roland's tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Recruit
Episodes.Description: Moises joins Gamma Sigma Xi's recruitment only to be later prohibited by Estong during an unexpected visit to his dorm. While the school administration turns a blind eye to Roland's murder, a Sagrado member expresses empathy for the victim's family.

Episodes.Title: Initiation
Episodes.Description: As part of their initiation into Gamma Sigma Xi, Moises and his friends obey whatever the members command them, affecting their academic performance. The Sagrado family strategizes their campaign for the upcoming national elections.

Episodes.Title: Lookout
Episodes.Description: After meeting Justin's parents, Moises realizes how fortunate the young Sagrado is. Later, Gov. Rafael taps Moises for a secret task. Meanwhile, Moises becomes increasingly intrigued by Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Favor
Episodes.Description: As a favor to Nadia, Moises begins asking around in hopes of uncovering the truth about Roland's death. Because of this, Justin grows increasingly wary of the newcomer's investigation.

Episodes.Title: Hell Night
Episodes.Description: The hell night has finally arrived for the potential new members of Gamma Sigma Xi as they reach the final stage of initiation. However, Justin ensures things will be much more difficult for Moises as the latter probes into Roland's death.

Episodes.Title: Member
Episodes.Description: The Gamma Sigma Xi members officially welcome Moises and his friends to their brotherhood. Estong discovers that Moises defied his orders and persisted in joining the fraternity.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises continues to get into Rafael's good graces, especially after the governor appreciated his kindness in helping the Salvacions seek justice for Roland's death. However, Moises' goodwill also brings Rafael closer to uncovering Justin's secret.

Episodes.Title: Pressure
Episodes.Description: Moises and his friends resort to desperate measures in hopes of squeezing the truth out of Percy. Meanwhile, unaware of yet another trouble Moises has gotten himself into, Estong refuses to give up on finding his estranged daughter.

Episodes.Title: Fear
Episodes.Description: Justin gloats as Crestwood University's administrators impose expulsion on Moises, seeking to silence his quest for justice for Roland. Meanwhile, Mercedes reverts to an old habit amid familial stress.

Episodes.Title: Ally
Episodes.Description: Moises reaches out to his Gamma Sigma Xi brothers for help in overturning the expulsion decision against him and his friends. Rafael pays the Salvacions a visit.

Episodes.Title: Reputation
Episodes.Description: The news about Moises' expulsion comes as a blow to Estong. Amid the campaign season for the upcoming national elections, the Sagrados pull strings to ensure that Roland's case stays under their control.

Episodes.Title: Scandal
Episodes.Description: Mercedes' jealousy catapults Rafael into a scandal, threatening her husband's candidacy. Moises' faith is tested as Estong's hospital bills start to pile up.

Episodes.Title: Damage Control
Episodes.Description: Rafael uses his housing project for damage control to gain favor with the voting public amidst his current issue. Estong's plea surprises Grace and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Overdose
Episodes.Description: Fearing her bloody secret would be exposed, Mercedes' restlessness leads her into danger. Fortunately, an unexpected guest in the mansion comes to her aid just in time. Elias continues to vie with Rafael for their party's presidential nomination.

Episodes.Title: Support
Episodes.Description: Mercedes recalls her dark secret as a strong sense of despair hits her. With Moises' readmittance to Crestwood, Justin prohibits him from further investigating Roland's death. Meanwhile, Rafael and Elias file for their candidacies.

Episodes.Title: Campaign
Episodes.Description: Moises and Grace volunteer to be part of Sagrados' campaign team as a gesture of gratitude for Rafael's unwavering assistance. Meanwhile, Nadia's suspicions against Rafael deepen, planting a seed of doubt in Moises.

Episodes.Title: Letter
Episodes.Description: Moises revisits Roland's old letters to Nadia in hopes of finding a connection between Percy and the late Crestwood student. Following the Sagrados’ successful campaign rally, a mysterious girl shows up and makes a surprising claim.

Episodes.Title: Guilty
Episodes.Description: A young woman shows up, claiming that Elias is her biological father. Meanwhile, Moises’ latest discovery sparks another conflict between him and Justin.

Episodes.Title: Proof
Episodes.Description: Maxene decides to join Felicia's sorority. Nadia confronts Rafael over her discovery about Percy. Moises finds a way to prove that Roland indeed applied to Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Heartbeat
Episodes.Description: Moises and Maxene form a deeper bond as they obtain the video that could implicate Justin in Roland's death. However, Moises finds himself in a dilemma as his family and friends remain loyal to the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Bribe
Episodes.Description: As Moises relentlessly pursues justice, Rafael attempts to threaten and bribe him. Meanwhile, Elias officially acknowledges Danica as his daughter and warmly welcomes her into his home.

Episodes.Title: Election
Episodes.Description: Election day has finally arrived. Meanwhile, the Sagrados use their connections to keep tabs on Moises as he continues assisting Nadia in finding concrete evidence to reopen Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Clash
Episodes.Description: The Sagrado tandem of Elias and Rafael celebrate their election victory. Justin confronts Moises at the fraternity house, resulting in a bloody brawl.

Episodes.Title: Uncovered Secret
Episodes.Description: Justin's recklessness strains his relationship with his father, forcing him to come clean to Mercedes. At the hospital, Rafael tries to downplay the altercation between his son and Moises.

Episodes.Title: Arrested
Episodes.Description: Estong angrily confronts Rafael after learning about what happened to Moises. Much to the Malonzos' indignance, Rafael soon turns the tables on Moises regarding Roland's case.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Moises and Justin face each other in the prosecutor's office, awaiting the decision on the former's murder case. While Moises receives unwavering support from his family, the Sagrados strengthen their bond in the face of adversity.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: As his uphill battle against the Sagrado family continues, Moises draws strength from his family and friends. Meanwhile, Danica airs her deep-seated grudges toward Elias and the Sagrado clan.

Episodes.Title: Setup
Episodes.Description: Unable to implicate Moises in Roland's murder, Justin ensures his former friend will face rightful punishment for defying him. Now the country's president, Elias defies Jaime's orders, much to the latter's annoyance.

Episodes.Title: Loyalty
Episodes.Description: Forced to go on the run, Moises turns to a Gamma Sigma Xi member for assistance. While Eleazar plants a seed of doubt in Rafael, Jaime confronts his brother for defying him.

Episodes.Title: Fugitive
Episodes.Description: After failing to capture Moi, Justin blatantly lies to the media, tarnishing his frat brother's reputation. Mercedes is left speechless by Diego's revelation. Rafael starts to entertain the possibility that Moi might be telling the truth.

Episodes.Title: Hulicam
Episodes.Description: Moises takes matters into his own hands and forces a confession from Justin. While her dark past continues to haunt Mercedes, Estong accosts Rafael for ruining his adopted son's life.

Episodes.Title: Blackmail
Episodes.Description: Diego uses Mercedes' dark past to blackmail her and extort money. As Moises' sole evidence against Justin falls into the Sagrados' hands, Maxene tells her friend that someone else still believes in his innocence.

Episodes.Title: Traitor
Episodes.Description: The manhunt operation against Moises continues as an unlikely person betrays him. While the Malonzos fight for justice, Eleazar starts to have second thoughts about the whole situation.

Episodes.Title: Stain
Episodes.Description: Eleazar is compelled to take action as Moises' case begins to tarnish the reputation of his family and the Gamma Sigma Xi. Meanwhile, Moises manages to get help from a Sagrado.

Episodes.Title: Defiance
Episodes.Description: Following Rafael's advice, Jaime devises a plan to prevent Elias from revealing the truth about their brotherhood's dilemma. Danica asks her dad to give Moi a chance to explain his side.

Episodes.Title: Hope
Episodes.Description: Moises finds renewed hope in Eleazar, unaware that the Sagrados remain one step ahead. Jaime reveals a shocking secret to his family as he decides to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Ingrate
Episodes.Description: Rafael is haunted by memories of a past romance as he tries to prove his love for Mercedes. Accused of ingratitude by Jaime, Eleazar soon faces the consequence of aiding Moises.

Episodes.Title: Dishonesty
Episodes.Description: Jaime fabricates more lies to cover up his crime. As Moises gets falsely implicated, Rafael starts to feel that his family's web of lies is spiraling out of control.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Diego tries to extort more money from Mercedes while revealing another shocking secret about the past. As Jaime grows determined to finish off Eleazar, Moises faces the media to confess.

Episodes.Title: Success
Episodes.Description: Jaime claims victory for the Sagrado family as Moises falsely confesses to all the crimes he is accused of. Meanwhile, Mercedes is haunted by a gruesome crime she committed in the past.

Episodes.Title: Threat
Episodes.Description: As Danica clings to hope for Eleazar's survival, Jaime urges Rafael to leverage his role as acting president for their family's benefit. Meanwhile, Moises faces the gravest threat to his life behind bars.

Episodes.Title: Conscience
Episodes.Description: With Moises' life in danger, Rafael and Divine's conscience pushes them to do the right thing. While trying to escape, Moises discovers the traitor in his midst.

Episodes.Title: Pit
Episodes.Description: With the discovery of human remains at the site of her housing project, Mercedes fears that her dark secret may soon be uncovered. Rafael tries to prove himself to Moises and earn his trust.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: Moises urges Rafael to do the right thing and expose the truth. The Vice President, meanwhile, finds himself keeping a secret from his own family as Jaime learns about the disappearance of their scapegoat.

Episodes.Title: Pagmulat
Episodes.Description: Rafael finds himself torn between helping Moises and protecting his own family. Meanwhile, Diego continues to extort Mercedes in exchange for his silence.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Rafael continues to aid Moises as Eleazar prepares to wage war against their family. Jaime remains unperturbed by the turn of events, putting Divine between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Abduction
Episodes.Description: Foiling Divine's plan to escape her daughter, Jaime exposes their dirty work to Felicia. An unforeseen incident threatens to ruin Moises' chance of proving his innocence. Meanwhile Eleazar talks with his brother.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Moises turns to a trusted ally for help after finding himself in danger at the hands of the police. As the Sagrado family grapples with Rafael's abduction, the Vice President comes face to face with his captor.

Episodes.Title: Answer
Episodes.Description: While Moises contacts his family, Rafael returns home following his abduction. Estong and Grace stumble upo the cop investigating the remains found at the site of Mercedes' housing project.

Episodes.Title: Anak
Episodes.Description: Rafael's mysterious abduction sparks questions and speculation from both the public and his family. Meanwhile, Mercedes decides to strike back against Diego.

Episodes.Title: Revelation
Episodes.Description: General Arevalo resorts to violence in hopes of uncovering the identity of Moises' protector. Estong and Grace's world comes crashing down upon learning about Cristine's fate.

Episodes.Title: Agreement
Episodes.Description: While Moises continues to place his trust in him, Rafael confides in Divine about his plan to save Justin. Eleazar finds himself embroiled in another controversy. Melanie returns home.

Episodes.Title: Decision
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace feel a strong sense of regret as they mourn for Cristine's passing. Eleazar is forced to make a big decision, putting Moises' fate in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Finish
Episodes.Description: Moises feels betrayed by Eleazar's decision, while the Sagrado family celebrates Rafael's rise to power. Mercedes makes a deal with Diego to get rid of Moises once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Standoff
Episodes.Description: When Diego returns empty-handed, Mercedes takes matters into her own hands. Meanwhile, Eleazar demands the return of his daughter and threatens Jaime, who remains oblivious to the betrayal brewing among those closest to him.

Episodes.Title: Doubt
Episodes.Description: Unaware of Danica's situation, Moises reaches out to her for help. Meanwhile, Nadia and Melanie suffer the consequence of aiding the Sagrados' archenemy.

Episodes.Title: Curse
Episodes.Description: While Rafael takes his oath as the new president, the police rush to Crestwood University in hopes of capturing Moises. Unbeknownst to them, a new ally comes to the boy's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Force
Episodes.Description: Estong and Grace storm into Rafael's oath-taking ceremony to demand that he fulfill his promise to Moises, only to land in jail. Eleazar gatecrashes the Sagrados' celebration.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: Eleazar causes a scene at the Sagrados' celebration to pressure Jaime into freeing Danica. As the Malonzos get released from jail, Rafael soon learns about what happened to Grace.

Episodes.Title: Frat War
Episodes.Description: While deep in thought about her family's dire situation, Grace receives a glimmer of hope. Justin and his brothers confront Prof. Elmer, suspecting that Omega Alpha Rho is harboring Moi.

Episodes.Title: Discovery
Episodes.Description: As Eleazar faces arrest on corruption charges, Jaime forms a new alliance to solidify his hold on power. Despite his friend's sacrifice, Moises falls into the hands of his enemies. Rafael visits the Malonzos to offer his help.

Episodes.Title: Sin
Episodes.Description: After meeting with the Malonzos to assure them of his help, Rafael finds himself haunted by memories of his sinful affair. General Arevalo pressures Moises into revealing the identity of his accomplice.

Episodes.Title: Trust
Episodes.Description: Rafael finally finds Danica, while Ernesto and Grace are forced to trust an old foe to flee from Jaime's men. Later, the president secretly digs deeper into Cristine's mysterious death.

Episodes.Title: Atonement
Episodes.Description: Burdened by guilt over Cristine's fate, Rafael feels compelled to atone for his mistakes by helping Moises. Much to his father's disgust, Justin makes an appalling suggestion involving the enemies of the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Rafael and his security team set out on a mission to rescue both Moises and Danica. The president's actions, however, start to raise suspicions in Jaime.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Justin grows furious at the thought of his father siding with Moises. To make matters worse for the Sagrados, Rafael's action empowers Eleazar to strike back and wage war against them.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: Jaime confronts Eleazar after his brother exposed his evil acts. While Rafael informs Justin about his deal with the ex-president, Mercedes grows increasingly fearful of what her husband might do once he learns the truth.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While defending Moises' innocence, Rafael exposes his and Jaime's wrongdoings. As Jaime prepares for his next move, Mercedes finds herself between a rock and a hard place.

Episodes.Title: Pillar
Episodes.Description: Rafael learns that Cristine had given birth to a child before she died. Diego seeks Nadia and Melanie's forgiveness, hiding his true motive in coming back to their lives. Jaime warns Rafael about the consequences of betraying him.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: Eleazar warns Rafael about the full extent of Jaime's plans for revenge. As anticipated, Jaime has one final trick up his sleeve to locate Moises and Danica. Meanwhile, Rafael gets transferred to a new detention center.

Episodes.Title: Kapalit
Episodes.Description: Rafael escapes with the Malonzos, though his life remains in grave danger. An old threat to Moises' life reemerges as Mercedes learns about her husband's investigation into Cristine's murder.

Episodes.Title: Wanted
Episodes.Description: Rafael becomes a wanted fugitive following his escape, with Jaime showing no mercy toward his once-adopted son. Meanwhile, Justin's anger toward his father intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Pagtatagpo
Episodes.Description: Rafael arranges a meeting with Mercedes and Justin. However, danger looms as Justin, devastated by the truth about Moises, betrays his father and informs Jaime about the rendezvous.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Following a shocking revelation, an emotional Justin forces Rafael to choose between him and Moises. Mercedes's world crumbles as her husband makes a heartbreaking choice after learning the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: The Attack
Episodes.Description: Eleazar stands his ground when Jaime intimidates him into revealing Rafael's whereabouts. Meanwhile, Rafael returns to Moises, unaware that his adoptive father is on his way to them.

Episodes.Title: Preparation
Episodes.Description: Moises reunites with Maxene, who offers to help him and his family escape. While their enemies go into hiding, Jaime prepares Justin for the inevitable battle against Moises and Rafael.

Episodes.Title: Disguise
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Moises, Grace and Ernesto assume false identities as they seek refuge in Maxene's hometown. However, Moises's attempt to be of help puts their cover at risk of being exposed.

Episodes.Title: Riot
Episodes.Description: Divine's attempt to convince Felicia to stay away from Justin leads to a tragedy. Rafael seizes the chance to learn more about Moises through Grace. A riot erupts as Eleazar fights for his rightful claim to the presidency.

Episodes.Title: Inspiration
Episodes.Description: As Moises draws inspiration from Maxene to dream once more for his family, Justin strives to restore his family's reputation. Despite the bad news, Eleazar's action proves advantageous for him.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: Rafael savors the time spent with Moises while pretending to be father and son. At the same time, Moises finds the love and peace he has longed for in Maxene. Meanwhile, Eleazar remains steadfast in his fight for truth and injustice.

Episodes.Title: Sabotage
Episodes.Description: While Moises and Maxene enjoy a romantic rendezvous, Matias hides a secret of his own. Rafael confronts Justin about his attempts to tarnish his reputation and sway public opinion against him.

Episodes.Title: Trump Card
Episodes.Description: Rafael makes a tough decision to atone for his family's crimes. Matias and his group plan an uprising against their corrupt mayor, hinting at a hidden trump card against their enemy. Felicia receives heartbreaking news about her father.

Episodes.Title: Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Elias urges his frat brothers to support his claim to the presidency, prompting Jaime to kick him out of Gamma Sigma XI. As he is about to leave, Rafael gets caught off guard by Matias's revelations. Unknown to them, danger looms over their heads.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: Lorenzo informs Jaime about a surprise for his upcoming birthday celebration. As the mayor's forces close in, Rafael and his allies fiend themselves in imminent danger.

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: While Nadia and Diego head out to meet the former first lady, Mercedes plans a new demolition job against Rafael. Together with the wanted ex-president, Mattias and his group prepare to launch an attack against on Lorenzo's drug den.

Episodes.Title: Unbothered
Episodes.Description: Shaira receives a stern warning from Jaime. Soon, a news report exposes Rafael's past relationship with Cristine and alleges his involvement in her tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: As an intense confrontation unfolds between Nadia and Mercedes, another life falls into the Sagrados' hands. While Rafael and Mattias launch an attack against Mayor Lorenzo, Moises secretly sets out to help them.

Episodes.Title: Rescue
Episodes.Description: Moises comes to Rafael's rescue, only to be caught by Mayor Lorenzo's men. Getting wind of the latest news, Estong confronts Rafael when he returns without Moises. Meanwhile, Kelvin finds himself in danger.

Episodes.Title: Captive
Episodes.Description: Moises risks his life to escape from his captors. Rafael denies the allegations of masterminding Cristine's death. While Grace believes in Rafael's innocence, Estrong grows increasingly suspicious of him.

Episodes.Title: Execution
Episodes.Description: Tragedy befalls Nadia amid her attempt to expose the truth. Rafael and Mattias sneak into Mayor Lorenzo's mansion to rescue Moises. Justin prepares to punish Kelvin for betraying Gamma Sigma Xi.

Episodes.Title: Defection
Episodes.Description: Unable to tolerate the brutal punishment inflicted on Kelvin, some frat members turn their backs on Justin and Gamma Sigma Xi. As controversies surround Jaime, cracks begin to form within his inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Gift
Episodes.Description: Divine and Felicia's chances of leaving the Sagrados dwindle after Justin learns about his girlfriend's pregnancy. An unexpected guest spoils Jaime's birthday celebration.

Episodes.Title: Blood Ties
Episodes.Description: As they finally come face-to-face with Moises, Jaime and Justin try to turn him against Rafael. Meanwhile, the former president seeks the help of a powerful ally in his mission to save his captured son.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: While Jaime anticipates a grand family reunion, bloody combat ensues between Justin and Moises in the latter's desperate attempt to escape. With his grandson in danger, Ernesto resolves to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Territory
Episodes.Description: Rafael, Elias, and Grace storm into Lorenzo's territory in a daring attempt to rescue Moises. Meanwhile, Moises and Estong's heartfelt reunion is cut short as they soon face grave danger.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Grief engulfs the Malonzos and their allies as Moises' freedom comes at a high price. Despite Justin's warning, Felicia and Divine make another attempt to escape from the Sagrados.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: Jaime remains deeply wounded by Rafael and Elias' betrayals. While Elias vows to help the Malonzos find justice for their sufferings, Maxene tries to stop Moises from taking the law into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: While Justin insists on marrying Felicia, Jaime confronts Divine for helping Rafael and Eleazar behind his back. Meanwhile, Moises reunites with his friends for refuge, unaware that Lorenzo's men have already tracked them down.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Mayor Lorenzo meets his downfall after his plans against Moises backfire on him. Rafael confronts Jaime about Moises' whereabouts and Cristine's death, unaware of a trap to capture him.

Episodes.Title: Father
Episodes.Description: Rafael spots Moises and attempts to bring him to safety, but Moises rejects him as his father and vows revenge on the Sagrados. Despite the growing public unrest, Justin pushes ahead with his plans to marry Felicia, unaware of the lurking threat.

Episodes.Title: Protest
Episodes.Description: With Grace and Melanie leading the charge, protesters claim victory as Jaime's allies fall one after another. While Eleazar reclaims his position, Jaime instructs Divine to plan their escape.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: While tragedy befalls Felicia after Justin discovers her betrayal, Jaime uses all means to escape upon realizing he has fallen into a trap. Soon, tables turn as Moises, and the other members of Gamma Sigma Xi hold Justin captive.

Episodes.Title: Brothers
Episodes.Description: After exposing the Sagrados' true face to the public, Moises ruthlessly punishes an unrepentant Justin. Rafael races against time to stop his sons fighting each other to the death.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Rafael joins Eleazar in his preparation for his presidential re-inauguration. Mercedes confronts Moises, only for the boy to learn the truth about Cristine's death.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: Standing at the crossroads, Rafael grapples with a heavy choice in order to save Moises' life. After Eleazar's re-inauguration ceremony ends in tragedy, a triumphant Jaime spills more blood.

Episodes.Title: Justice
Episodes.Description: After losing his remaining ally, Jaime attempts to kill Moises, but an unexpected person arrives to save the young Sagrado. Soon, retribution comes for the vicious kingmaker.

Episodes.Title: Changes
Episodes.Description: Rafael and Justin face their punishment, but not before reconciling with Moises. As Roland finally gets the justice he deserves, Moises leads a major change in Gamma Sigma Xi.
